name: ref-tools
description: Claude Code plugins for Ref — documentation search, refs, and UI sweep.

plugins.name: ref-context
plugins.description: Documentation search over public and private docs via the Ref Context MCP server.

plugins.name: ref-plan
plugins.description: List, read, and write refs, and coordinate sub-agents.

plugins.name: ui-sweep
plugins.description: Agent skill to sweep a web app feature's UI end to end: sandbox the app, catalog every screen into a Ref, report bugs with fix proposals, leave a reusable .ui-sweep/ scaffold; with --fix, ship draft PRs and work the review loop.
